metadata.description: Marketplace for the Obsidian Memory plugins (Claude Code and Cowork)

plugins.name: obsidian-memory
plugins.description: Persistent per-project memory for Claude Code: an Obsidian vault (obsidian-vault/) with a context CLAUDE.md, session history, specs, plans and decisions. Git and Obsidian are optional.

plugins.name: obsidian-memory-cowork
plugins.description: Persistent per-project memory for Claude Cowork: reads and writes the same obsidian-vault/ used by the Obsidian Memory plugin for Claude Code, with file tools only (no hooks, scripts or git).
